# Zenple App Context for AI

## Overview
Zenple: Focus & Be productive. Zenple is a focus timer application designed to help users lock their phones, beat distractions, and significantly boost their everyday productivity.

## Core Philosophy
- Focus & Be productive.
- Lock your phone, beat distractions.
- Provide a structured way to handle deep work and boost productivity without losing momentum.

## Key Features
- **Focus Timers:** Start, pause, resume easily. Defaults: 25/50/90 minutes, plus custom times to lock in focus.
- **Category Insights:** Users tag sessions (e.g., Learning, Fitness) to track long-term productivity trends privately.
- **Tokens & Slogans:** Gamification through small rewards (tokens) and motivational rotating slogans to maintain momentum.
- **Multi-language:** Supports English, Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), Simplified Chinese (简体中文).
- **Beat Distractions:** Subtle, fully customizable chimes designed to keep focus sharp.
- **Privacy-first:** Data is kept minimal and private by design.

## Target Audience
Students, engineers, and anyone looking to beat distractions, lock their phone, and instantly boost their productivity.

## Metadata & Links
- **Platform:** Android (Google Play Store)
- **App ID:** com.zenplelife.zenple
- **Download Link:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zenplelife.zenple
